newsitem.title: ITALY: FORECAST -- Italy seen issuing 18 trln lire Btp, CCT.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST -- Italy seen issuing 18 trln lire Btp, CCT.

text.p: The Italian Treasury is seen issuing 15.0 to 20.5 trillion lire of medium and long term paper (or an average 18.0 trillion lire) against some 37.455 trillion lire of fixed rate Btp bonds and CCT floating rate certificates maturing, a Reuter poll showed on Friday.

The Treasury will announce the amounts it will offer on December 23. On Thursday, the Treasury announced that it would offer a seventh tranche of November 1 2003 CCT, with a 3.8 percent coupon, and a ninth tranche of November 1 2006 Btp with a 7.75 percent coupon. Settlement for the paper is on January 2.

Also on January 2, it will offer a new tranche of January 1 2000 Btp with a reduced coupon of 6.00 percent (from a previous 7.5 percent) and January 1 2002 Btp with a 6.25 percent coupon (lower than the previous 7.75 percent). Settlement for the bills is on January 7.
At the start of January, in addition to the 37.455 trillion lire of BTP and CCT maturing, 9.2 trillion lire of coupons payments also expire.
